items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: It was Mac Daniels' band, Mac Daniels, he was a violin player. And I played in that theater eight years in the pit there.

ctx.x: What was the name of the band there?
It was Mac Daniels' band, Mac Daniels, he was a violin player. And I played in that theater eight years in the pit there.
Because playing in pits you had to read?
